BOOK ONE · LESSON 114

I've got none. 我没有。

我没有。

Lesson 114 is a picture lesson about 'none', 'no' and 'any' in negative sentences. Twelve pictures (o-z) show pairs of people asking about chocolate, envelopes and cake, with answers using 'I haven't got any', 'I've got no...', 'I've got none', 'Neither have I' and 'So have I'. The written exercises and grammar workbook section focus on rewriting sentences with 'no' and answering questions using the 'any/no/none' pattern.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Twelve pictures (o-z) in groups of three: o-q chocolate/envelopes (Have you got any? / I haven't got any. I've got no... I've got none. / I haven't any either. Neither have I.), r-t envelopes (same pattern), u-w cake (Have you got any? / I've got some. / So have I.), x-z cookies (same pattern).

十二张图片（o-z）分三组：o-q 巧克力/信封（你有吗？/ 我没有。我没有……我一点也没有。/ 我也没有。我也一点没有。），r-t 信封（同），u-w 蛋糕（你有吗？/ 我有一些。/ 我也有。），x-z 饼干（同）。

Listen and answer the questions
